description: Password breach check (HIBP) — Has this password appeared in known breaches? Pass password (hashed server-side, only a 5-char prefix is sent upstream via k-anonymity) or a SHA-1 hash; returns pwned flag + breach count. Source: HaveIBeenPwned. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

sha1.description: optional SHA-1 hash instead of password

name: security_pwned_password
